text: dsh-webview 是供 DSH 桌面端使用的 DeepSeek 网页内嵌面板。它在侧边栏、主区域和会话视图标签提供入口，共用一个浏览器页面；可打开 chat.deepseek.com、刷新页面，并将外部链接交给系统浏览器。插件把可读取的页面存储快照保存到 DSH 外壳，以便进程重启后尝试恢复登录状态。适合希望在 DSH 中查阅 DeepSeek 网页会话并保持页面状态的桌面用户。需要 DeepSeek 账号登录。

dsh-webview embeds DeepSeek web in DSH Desktop, with shared sidebar and conversation view entry points. Open chat.deepseek.com, reload it, or send links to the system browser. A readable page storage snapshot is kept locally for session restoration after restart. Sign in with a DeepSeek account.

dsh-webview 的功能「多入口网页面板」：在 DSH 桌面端侧边栏、主区域和会话视图标签打开 DeepSeek 网页，多个入口共用同一页面实例。
dsh-webview 的功能「登录状态恢复」：页面加载后读取可访问的 localStorage 与 cookie 快照并存入 DSH 外壳，之后尝试在新页面恢复，必要时重载一次。
dsh-webview 的功能「网页工具栏」：面板提供首页、刷新和在浏览器打开按钮，用户可返回 DeepSeek 首页、重新加载当前页面或交由系统浏览器处理。
dsh-webview 的功能「外部链接处理」：内嵌页只继续访问 DeepSeek 域名，其他导航会停止并交给系统浏览器打开。
dsh-webview 使用前须知：内嵌浏览器需要 DSH Desktop 提供的 browser 桥；其他运行环境显示降级提示，可改用系统浏览器打开 DeepSeek。
dsh-webview 使用前须知：首次使用需在内嵌的 DeepSeek 页面登录账号；页面无法读取的 HttpOnly cookie 不会进入恢复快照，因此重启后可能需要重新登录。

> 🤖 **本插件完全由 AI 制作**：代码、文档、图标均由 DSH 内的 AI agent 生成，未经人工逐行编写。

dsh-webview README · 三个入口，一个页面：| 入口 | 位置 | 适合 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **会话视图标签** | 会话区顶部「对话｜轨迹｜上下文」旁的 **网页端** | 边聊边查，跟着当前会话走 |
| **左上角面板列** | 「插件」「自动化任务」旁的地球图标 | 全屏使用，随时进出 |
| **主区域面板** | 上面两个入口点开后的全屏面板 | 沉浸式，左侧栏仍可操作 |

三个入口**共享同一个页面实例**：在标签里滚到某处，切到面板再切回来，页面还在原处；登录状态、正在输入的内容都不会丢。

---

dsh-webview README · 为什么选它：同类插件大多只提供一个全局面板。dsh-webview 的差异点：

| 维度 | dsh-webview | 常见内嵌方案 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 会话视图标签入口 | ✅ 有（同类中未见） | ❌ 只有全局按钮 |
| 多入口共享同一页面 | ✅ 三个入口一个实例，切走不卸载 | ⚠️ 少见 |
| 宿主半侧代码 | ✅ 零（`lib/index.js` 是空插件，只为让加载器看见） | ⚠️ 通常需要，用来搬运 HttpOnly cookie |
| 页面权限 | ✅ 最小：不读文件、不碰凭证、不发请求 | ⚠️ 视实现而定 |
| 导航范围 | ✅ 白名单 `deepseek.com`，越界交系统浏览器 | ⚠️ 多为不限制 |
| 体积 / 依赖 | ✅ 单文件约 22KB，零运行时依赖，无构建步骤 | ⚠️ 常见数百 KB 起 |

**不代你发请求**：不注入页面脚本、不轮询接口、不预加载、不代理任何请求。插件做的事只有一件——把网页端放进一个受控的内嵌浏览器里。

dsh-webview README · 安装：桌面端自带包管理器，**不需要自己装 Node.js**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-webview
```

装完重启 DSH：左上角面板列出现地球图标，会话区标签栏多一个「网页端」。

离线安装（把 `dsh-webview-0.3.0.tgz` 放在本地）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-webview-0.3.0.tgz"
```

---

dsh-webview README · 使用：1. 任选一个入口打开：会话区顶部的 **网页端** 标签，或左上角的地球图标
2. 第一次在页面里登录 DeepSeek 账号（之后重启 DSH 通常不必再登录）
3. 顶部工具条提供 **刷新** 与 **在浏览器打开**

**那个"使用环境异常"弹窗**：DSH 桌面端是 Electron 容器，DeepSeek 的风控会识别出"这不是常规浏览器"。本插件只剥离 UA 里的 `Electron/<版本>` 标记，其余 Chromium 指纹原样保留——不冒充别的浏览器、不伪造版本号。绝大多数情况下不再出现；若偶尔出现，直接关掉即可，**不影响登录和对话**。

---

dsh-webview README · 登录是怎么保住的：宿主给内嵌页面的是**内存分区**（随机名、无 `persist:` 前缀，关掉进程就清空），所以插件自己保存会话快照：

- 页面加载完成、切换面板、关闭窗口时，读出页面的 `localStorage` 与脚本可读的 cookie，存进 DSH 外壳的 `localStorage`
- 下次启动时，在页面自身脚本初始化**之前**把快照写回去，有变化只重载一次；期间盖一层遮罩，看不到登录页闪烁

快照与浏览器"记住登录"是同一性质，**只存在你这台机器上**，不上传、不联网。`HttpOnly` cookie 页面读不到，所以极少数情况下仍需重新登录一次。

dsh-webview README · 已知限制：- **仅桌面端**：网页版 DSH 没有 Electron 宿主，面板会提示"当前环境不支持内嵌浏览器"
- **页面权限受限**：摄像头、麦克风、剪贴板读取、下载默认不可用（宿主安全策略）
- **标签栏依赖会话**：没有任何打开的会话时，会话视图标签栏不渲染，此时用左上角图标进入
- **面板位置固定**：按钮在左侧面板列末尾

| 0.2.1-rc.1 及以上（desktop） | 已验证可用 |
| 网页版 DSH | 不支持（显示降级提示） |

插件只依赖公开的客户端插槽（`sidebar.panellist` / `main` / `conversation.view`）与宿主 `dshDesktop.browser` 桥。同一 0.2.x 小版本更新一般无需改动；跨大版本可能需小幅适配。

dsh-webview README · 实现要点：- 注册三个插槽：`sidebar.panellist`（左上角按钮）、`main`（主区域面板）、`conversation.view`（会话区标签）；后两者与前者共用同一个 `<webview>` 实例
- 通过 `window.dshDesktop.browser.acquire()` 申请 lease 与内存分区，再创建 `<webview>`
- 保活：`<webview>` 挂在 `document.body` 上的单例容器里，面板切换只改 `display`，DOM 永不离场，页面因此不重载
- 导航白名单 `deepseek.com`；越界链接交给系统浏览器（2 秒内同一 URL 去重，避免重复弹窗）
- UA：`webview.setUserAgent()` 只去掉 `Electron/x.y.z`，保留其余 Chromium 标记

dsh-webview README · Three entry points, one page：| Entry | Where | Good for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Session view tab** | A **网页端 (Web)** tab next to 对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文 above the conversation | Checking something mid-chat, follows the active session |

| **Main-area panel** | The full-screen panel those two open | Immersive, sidebar still usable |

dsh-webview README · Three entry points, one page：All three **share a single page instance**: scroll somewhere in the tab, switch to the panel and back, and the page is still where you left it. Sign-in state and half-typed messages survive.

dsh-webview README · Why this one：Most comparable plugins give you one global panel. What makes dsh-webview different:

dsh-webview README · Why this one：| | dsh-webview | Typical embedded browser plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Session-view tab entry | ✅ yes (not seen elsewhere) | ❌ global button only |
| Entries sharing one page | ✅ three entries, one instance, never unmounted | ⚠️ rare |
| Host-side code | ✅ none (`lib/index.js` is an empty plugin, only there so the loader sees the entry) | ⚠️ usually needed, to move HttpOnly cookies |
| Page capabilities | ✅ minimal: no file access, no credentials, no replayed requests | ⚠️ varies |
| Navigation scope | ✅ whitelist `deepseek.com`, anything else goes to the system browser | ⚠️ often unrestricted |
| Size / deps | ✅ ~22KB single file, zero runtime dependencies, no build step | ⚠️ usually hundreds of KB |

dsh-webview README · Why this one：**It never sends requests on your behalf**: no injected scripts, no API polling, no preloading, no proxying. It does exactly one thing — puts the web client into a sandboxed embedded browser.

```bash

dsh-webview README · Usage：1. Open either entry: the **网页端** tab above the conversation, or the globe icon in the top-left rail
2. Sign in to your DeepSeek account once inside the page (after that a DSH restart usually needs no re-login)
3. The toolbar offers **reload** and **open in browser**

dsh-webview README · Usage：**About the "unusual environment" notice**: DSH Desktop is an Electron container, and DeepSeek's risk control can tell it is not an ordinary browser. This plugin only strips the `Electron/<version>` token from the user agent and keeps every other Chromium fingerprint intact — it does not impersonate another browser or fake a version number. In most cases the notice stops appearing; if it still shows up, just dismiss it. **It does not affect sign-in or chatting.**

---

dsh-webview README · How sign-in survives a restart：The host gives embedded pages an **in-memory partition** (random name, no `persist:` prefix, wiped when the process exits), so the plugin stores a session snapshot itself:

dsh-webview README · How sign-in survives a restart：- When the page finishes loading, when the panel is switched away, and when the window closes, it reads the page's `localStorage` and script-readable cookies and stores them in the DSH shell's `localStorage`
- On the next launch it writes the snapshot back **before the page's own scripts initialise**, reloads at most once, and covers the page meanwhile so you never see a login-page flash

dsh-webview README · How sign-in survives a restart：The snapshot is exactly the same kind of data as "remember me" in a browser, **stays on your machine**, is never uploaded and never touches the network. `HttpOnly` cookies are not readable from the page, so in rare cases one extra sign-in is still needed.

---

dsh-webview README · Known limitations：- **Desktop only**: the web build of DSH has no Electron host, so the panel shows "embedded browser is not available in this environment"
- **Restricted page capabilities**: camera, microphone, clipboard read and downloads are unavailable by default (host security policy)
- **The tab needs a session**: with no conversation open the session view bar is not rendered; use the top-left icon instead
- **Fixed position**: the button sits at the end of the left panel rail

| --- | --- |
| 0.2.1-rc.1 and later (desktop) | verified working |
| Web build of DSH | unsupported (shows a fallback notice) |

The plugin only relies on public client slots (`sidebar.panellist` / `main` / `conversation.view`) and the host `dshDesktop.browser` bridge. Patch releases within 0.2.x generally need no changes; a major bump may need small adjustments.

dsh-webview README · Implementation notes：- Registers three slots: `sidebar.panellist` (top-left button), `main` (main-area panel) and `conversation.view` (session tab); the latter two share the same `<webview>` instance as the first
- Acquires a lease and an in-memory partition via `window.dshDesktop.browser.acquire()`, then creates the `<webview>`
- Keep-alive: the `<webview>` lives in a singleton container on `document.body`; switching panels only toggles `display`, the DOM never leaves, so the page never reloads
- Navigation whitelist `deepseek.com`; external links go to the system browser (same URL deduplicated within 2 seconds to avoid duplicate prompts)
- UA: `webview.setUserAgent()` removes only `Electron/x.y.z`, keeping the rest of the Chromium markers

dsh-webview README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-webview
```

dsh-webview README · Development：```
lib/index.js     host half (empty plugin, only so the loader entry is visible)
lib/client.js    browser half (slots + webview), loaded through window.__ModuleLoader__
cordis.patch.yml bundle patch that inserts the entry with id `webview`
```
